# Technical Presentation and Speaker Enablement Program

**Period:** 2019–2020
**Role:** Outreach Technical Writer
**Organization:** Technical Content Management

## Context

Technical staff — engineers, data scientists, product managers — regularly presented at external conferences and internal events but lacked centralized resources, templates, and support for creating high-quality technical presentations. Conference proposal guidance, slide deck standards, and rehearsal processes were fragmented or nonexistent.

## Challenge

Build a scalable speaker enablement program from scratch that provides consistent support for technical presenters across the company, while establishing processes that could function beyond a single person's involvement.

## Approach

- Created a Conference Quick Start Hub with a directory of conference resources, guides on writing a conference proposal, and preparing for external presentations. Content was organized for technical roles. Fulfilled a team key result for engineering presentation standards.
- Designed customized slide deck templates and planning documents for event presenters.
- Provided end-to-end support for individual presenters: content development, slide design, data sharing compliance review, rehearsal facilitation, and videographer coordination.
- Delivered a 75-minute Mindfulness for Public Speaking training session, voluntary and open to all employees, focused on reducing public speaking anxiety.
- Expanded into the Open Source Ambassador Program in 2020, creating custom slide decks and mentoring team members. Documented event-organizing processes to enable continuity.
- Integrated speaker support into broader team services, including external presentation compliance review and conference proposal writing assistance.

## Outcomes

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| External talks supported (Q4 2019) | 13 |
| Conference proposals assisted (both accepted) | 2 |
| Training attendance | 18 of 27 registrants |
| Reported confidence increase | 10 of 15 survey respondents |
| Would recommend training | 14 of 15 survey respondents |

Selected conferences supported: PyCon, Open Source Summit EU, DevRelCon London, Open Data Science Conference, SeaGL, Litmus Live.
